video_title: What's next after the Ja Morant trade⁉️ NBA Free Agency outlook 👀 | NBA on ESPN

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Atlanta Hawks declined Bruno Fernando's option for roster flexibility
quotes.excerpt: It basically gives them the flexibility to go out and try to get a center
quotes.quote: Atlanta declined the Bruno Fernando option. He is an unrestricted free agent. The reason why is it basically gives them the flexibility to go out and try to get a center with their $15 million exception. That would not have been the case if they had picked up the option.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston Celtics unlikely to make moves regarding Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I would not be surprised if Boston does not do anything with Jaylen Brown
quotes.quote: We have talked at length regarding Jaylen Brown. We are not going to talk about that again. I would not be surprised if Boston does not do anything with Jaylen Brown.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Brooklyn Nets use room exception to preserve roster flexibility
quotes.excerpt: I would not be surprised if he goes into the room exception to preserve flexibility for Brooklyn
quotes.quote: Brooklyn agreed to terms with Day'Ron Sharpe. I would not be surprised if he goes into the room exception to preserve flexibility for Brooklyn. They have somewhere between roughly up to $40 million. It is very fluid as far as their situation. Josh Minott, two years, $9 million.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: James Harden declines player option and expects to re-sign with Clippers
quotes.excerpt: Expect James Harden back, Thomas Bryant on the veteran minimum exception
quotes.quote: James Harden declines his $42 million player option. It was a mutual option. There was $13 million guaranteed. It was a no-brainer. Basically what will happen is you will probably see Harden's number between $32-33 million. There will be a second year attached to basically make up the money that he lost. Expect James Harden back, Thomas Bryant on the veteran minimum exception.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Detroit Pistons sign Kevin Huerter to three-year deal
quotes.excerpt: Detroit signs Kevin Huerter, three years, $27 million
quotes.quote: Detroit signs Kevin Huerter, three years, $27 million. We will keep an eye on what happens with Jalen Duren. I know there is a lot of speculation about sign-and-trades. I do not see Detroit at all engaging with teams regarding sign-and-trades. I do not see Detroit not matching an offer sheet.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's opt-out impacts Golden State's salary cap and flexibility
quotes.excerpt: When you opt out of $28 million, you are not going to go in canvas the marketplace
quotes.quote: Draymond Green has opted out. When you opt out of $28 million, you are not going to go in canvas the marketplace. You are not going to Brooklyn and you are not going to Chicago. If you add $15 million for LeBron James, you do not have anything else to fill out and it would not even be allowed. Basically you would make a trade and clear out room.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden State Warriors would trade Jimmy Butler to acquire Anthony Davis
quotes.excerpt: If there was ever an Anthony Davis trade, Jimmy Butler would have to be included
quotes.quote: We heard a lot about Anthony Davis today. The Wizards are probably saying, wait a minute, that player is on their contract and we would like to extend him. If there was ever an Anthony Davis trade, and I am not saying that it is going to happen or if it has legs or we are in the ballpark here, Jimmy Butler would have to be included. If the Warriors have a chance to get LeBron James and they have to get Anthony Davis to do it, they are going to trade Jimmy Butler.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Los Angeles Clippers trade options for Kawhi Leonard's extension
quotes.excerpt: If there is a trade, it would likely be Brandon Ingram and Grady Dick
quotes.quote: If there is a trade, it would likely be Brandon Ingram and Grady Dick. It is a matter of draft equity. Is it two first-round picks? Is it three first-round picks? Is it a swap? Kawhi Leonard is extension-eligible. You can add another two years on there. I think if you are the Clippers, you are looking at all options basically to get younger.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Memphis Grizzlies roster management after trading for Ja Morant
quotes.excerpt: They have an abundance of bigs
quotes.quote: Memphis makes the Ja Morant trade. They bring in Jeremy Grant, Chris Murray. They have an abundance of bigs. They have 11 bigs when you include Cam Boozer and Zach Edey and they picked up Jeremy Grant and Chris Murray. They are going to have to balance out that roster. Andrew Wiggins basically opts in and then signs for two more years on an extension.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Portland Trail Blazers trade for Ja Morant
quotes.excerpt: Portland, of course, they make the Ja trade. They have an abundance of guards
quotes.quote: Portland, of course, they make the Ja trade. They have an abundance of guards. Ja, Drew Holiday, Dame, Scoot, Shaedon Sharpe. As I always say, there is a part one and there is a part two and there is a part three and there will be a part two to this trade here. Somebody is going to have to go here. They do it at the cost of Jeremy Grant and Chris Murray.
